crossRefs.note: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,
Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before Yahweh to the war,
I commanded you at that time, saying, “Yahweh your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor…

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: “Remember the word which Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, saying, ‘Yahweh your God gives you rest, and will give you this land.
translations.bsb: “Remember what Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you when he said, ‘The LORD your God will give you rest, and He will give you this land.’
translations.kjv: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, The LORD your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.
translations.asv: Remember the word which Moses the servant of Jehovah commanded you, saying, Jehovah your God giveth you rest, and will give you this land.
